title: 2015 HMMT November Team Problem 1
statement: Triangle \(A B C\) is isosceles, and \(\angle A B C=x^{\circ}\). If the sum of the possible measures of \(\angle B A C\) is \(240^{\circ}\), find \(x\).

solutions.text:
Answer: 20
There are three possible triangles: either \(\angle A B C=\angle B C A\), in which case \(\angle B A C=180-2 x, \angle A B C=\) \(\angle B A C\), in which case \(\angle B A C=x\), or \(\angle B A C=\angle B C A\), in which case \(\angle B A C=\frac{180-x}{2}\). These sum to \(\frac{540-3 x}{2}\), so we have \(\frac{540-3 x}{2}=240 \Longrightarrow x=20\).
